# Python Template

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A Python (Jinja2) template determines the structure, layout, and configuration for various types of notes in the PKM system.

## Scope note

{% raw %}- Includes PKM Python template system using Jinja2 templates with Mustache syntax (`{{ ... }}`) that are used to generate Obsidian notes from Python (and/or Swift) services, scripts, commands, and agents.
- Distinguished from templates created with the Obsidian Templater plugin, with optional inline Templater expressions (`<% ... %>`) and JavaScript code.{% endraw %}
